{{Quote|I didn't take it as a trophy. The Lasat guardsman I faced…he…fought well, died with honor. He gave me the rifle before…|Agent Kallus, to [[Garazeb Orrelios]]|<ref name="The Honorable Ones" />}}
During the [[Siege of Lasan]], a [[Gender|male]] [[Lasat]] served in the '''Lasan High Honor Guard'''. He owned a [[J-19 bo-rifle]].<ref name="Droids in Distress" /> During the Siege, he fought [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus]], and was defeated by him. Following the Lasat tradition of [[Boosahn Keeraw]], he gave Kallus the [[bo-rifle]] before [[Death|dying]], as he had been bested by a superior opponent.<ref name="The Honorable Ones" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Honor Guard is first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] episode "[[Droids in Distress]]."<ref name="Droids in Distress" /> The ''Rebels'' Facebook page erroneously describes the rifle as a trophy taken by Kallus,<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=starwarsrebels|url=starwarsrebels/photos/a.230754950414469.1073741828.180356405454324/351522471671049/?type=3&theater|name=Star Wars Rebels|date=10-9-2014|quote=Kallus took his bo-rifle as a trophy from an Honor Guard whom he defeated in battle during the destruction of Lasan.|archivefile=File:Agent_Kallus_bo-rifle.png}}</ref> which was disproven by the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|''Rebels'' Season Two]] episode "[[The Honorable Ones]]," where more is learned about the exact circumstances under which Kallus fought him.<ref name="The Honorable Ones" />
